text:
Gold Price in 1992
Among 12 monthly observations available for 1992, the LBMA gold price fell 6.0% between 1992-01-31 ($354) and 1992-12-30 ($333). The highest sampled price was $358 in July and the lowest was $333 in December. The mean of these observations was $343. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
